_about: People texts of tools in English (summary + params help). Same keys as it/tools.json.

agenda.summary: Shows the agenda events of the next 7 days.

agenda_assistant.summary: Hestia's own agenda: what the assistant and its modules have planned — windows, periodic jobs, repair tasks, events.

agenda_assistant_add.summary: Adds an event/task/window/job to Hestia's agenda.

agenda_assistant_cancel.summary: Cancels an entry of Hestia's agenda for good.

agenda_assistant_link.summary: Links an entry to a parent entry: cancelling the parent cancels the child, the child's error marks the parent.

agenda_assistant_from_template.summary: Creates an entry of Hestia's agenda from a module template.

agenda_assistant_run.summary: Runs the action of a job/task of Hestia's agenda now.

agenda_assistant_templates.summary: Templates the modules offer to create entries.

agenda_assistant_restore.summary: Restores a skipped occurrence of an entry of Hestia's agenda.

agenda_assistant_skip.summary: Skips the next occurrence of an entry of Hestia's agenda, without deleting the rule.

agenda_assistant_move.summary: Moves/changes an entry of Hestia's agenda.

agenda_assistant_move_occurrence.summary: Moves only one occurrence of a recurring entry; reset=true brings it back to the original time.

agenda_standard.summary: Hestia's standard tasks with their state: active, changed, paused, deleted, failed; plus templates to add more.

params.owner: only the activities of this area (empty = all)

agenda_standard_restore.summary: Puts a standard task back as its module planned it.

updates_rollback.summary: Goes back to the Hestia version before the last update.

updates_install.summary: Installs the new Hestia version; only on explicit request.

updates_status.summary: Installed Hestia version, whether there is a new one and what it brings.

look_now.summary: What the site looks like now and why.

look_pet.summary: Creates a companion pet and asks for its images.

look_generate.summary: Ask for the images again: target profile or pet; ref = profile key or pet id/name.

look_next.summary: The themes of the next days.

look_choice.summary: For a client: auto=false turns themes off, true turns them back on; pet = pet id or name, empty for none.

assistant_profile.summary: Hestia's persona, the user's tone and instructions, and what Hestia remembers about the user, as one block to follow when the user switches Hestia on inside…

athena_audit_conversation.summary: Run a quality audit on recent conversation turns using the 26B reasoning model.

athena_commitment_resolve.summary: Closes a commitment of the assistant: done or no longer needed.

athena_signals.summary: Short signals each area publishes on its data, the weekly numbers, the links found between weeks and the recent observations of the reflection.

params.limit: How many signals (default 50, most important first)

atlas_recipe.summary: Uses a recipe for a site: recipe + parameters → extracted fields.

backup_list.summary: List of the backups on Google Drive.

backup_run.summary: Make an encrypted backup of all data on Google Drive now.

backup_status.summary: Backup status: last backup, last check, problems, Google Drive linked.

calendar_check.summary: Checks the next days of the calendar: if two commitments overlap it proposes where to move one.

calendar_list_events.summary: Lists the events in a time range per calendar provider.

calendar_update_event.summary: Updates fields of an existing calendar event.

home_command.summary: Commands a device: command on|off|toggle|open|close|lock|unlock; value = brightness % for lights or degrees for climate.

home_favorite.summary: Saves a quick action: device, label, room, command.

home_scene.summary: Runs a Home Assistant scene or action.

home_status.summary: How the home is now: lights on, temperatures, open doors/windows, quick actions.

chronos_reconcile.summary: Runs reconciliation maintenance in the Chronos module.

params.dry_run: If true only simulates without starting the worker ticks

food_diet.summary: The diet: with no arguments it shows it; kcal, protein, rules and notes change it.

food_supplement.summary: Add or change a supplement: name, dose, time_of_day morning|midday|afternoon|evening|any, days, training_days_only, with_food, status active|paused.

food_today.summary: Today's summary: meals, kcal and protein against the diet, supplements.

food_meal.summary: Logs a meal: text, slot breakfast|lunch|dinner|snack, kcal and protein if known.

coach_add_busy.summary: Marks a period when the user is away or busy, so the plan leaves it free.

coach_move.summary: Moves an entry of the weekly plan to another day/time.

coach_replan.summary: Redoes the plan from the given day to the end of the week.

coach_review.summary: How last week went against the plan: done, skipped, notes of each area.

params.date: a day of the week AFTER the one to review

coach_skip.summary: Skips an entry of the weekly plan; the rest of the week is replanned.

coach_week.summary: The user's weekly plan: workouts, routines and the rest placed in their free time, goals, what does not fit and why.

params.date: a day of the wanted week YYYY-MM-DD (empty = this one)

create_event.summary: Creates a new event in the linked calendar.

params.title: Title or name of the event
params.start_datetime: Start date and time in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
params.end_datetime: End date and time in ISO 8601 format
params.description: Description or extra notes of the event
params.location: Physical or virtual place of the event

docs_check.summary: Checks whether the repo docs follow the code and proposes the fixes to development.

document_create.summary: Creates a PDF, Word or Excel: title, html, format pdf|docx|xlsx, theme classico|moderno|sobrio, must_contain.

document_created_send.summary: Sends the file of a created document again.

documents.search.summary: Search through uploaded documents and files for relevant content.

params.subject: Subject
params.thread_id: Thread ID to reply in an existing thread

email_subscriptions.summary: Shows which modules receive which emails and the latest deliveries.

feedback_submit.summary: Store a quality grade for a chat interaction.

fetch_url.summary: Fetch web page content from a URL via host browser.

finance_add.summary: Logs an expense or an income.

finance_budget.summary: This month's budget per category and total, with what was spent.

finance_import_statement.summary: PDF bank statement sent in chat: first a preview, then, after the user's yes, import_id + commit=true.

finance_search.summary: Search transactions: query, category, month or since/until yyyy-mm-dd, account, to_review.

finance_set_budget.summary: Sets the monthly budget of a category.

finance_stats.summary: Trend of the last months: totals, per category, merchants.

finance_summary.summary: This month's expenses: spent, income, budget, pace, categories, main merchants, upcoming recurring payments.

finance_update.summary: Fix a transaction: category, amount, date, merchant, note.

fitness_activities.summary: This week's outdoor activities: intentions with progress, planned moments and activities done.

fitness_activity_outcome.summary: Outcome of a planned moment: outcome done|missed|moved.

fitness_adapt_today.summary: Propose today's workout adapted to how I am.

fitness_checkin.summary: Saves how I feel today: energy 1-5, sleep 1-5, soreness, pain, minutes available.

fitness_confirm_activity.summary: Confirms the proposed intention: slots = numbers of the moments to keep or iso times chosen by the user.

fitness_edit_template.summary: Changes a workout plan: remove/add exercise, sets and reps.

fitness_exercise_stats.summary: Records and trend of an exercise.

fitness_feedback.summary: Saves feedback on the workout or an exercise.

fitness_finish_session.summary: Ends the current workout: summary and new records.

fitness_log_activity.summary: Logs an activity done: kind, date, minutes, km, note.

fitness_log_measurement.summary: Logs body weight or a measurement.

fitness_log_sets.summary: Logs sets in the current workout from text: 'bench 80x8, 80x8, 77.5x7; pull-ups 8, 7, 6'.

fitness_next_workout.summary: The next workout with exercises, suggested weights and the reason.

fitness_plan_activity.summary: Outdoor activity intention: kind run|bike|walk|swim|other, times, place, minutes, week.

fitness_set_goal.summary: Sets a workout goal: times per day|week|month; scope any, template or muscle.

fitness_skip_day.summary: Marks a day's workout as skipped.

fitness_summary.summary: Training at a glance: next workout, goal, recent records, plateaus, skipped days, low energy signals.

fitness_templates.summary: My workout plans with exercises and duration.

fitness_undo_template.summary: Undoes the last change of a workout plan.

forge_approve.summary: Approves a Forge task: if 'proposed' it starts it, if 'awaiting_review' it applies the change.

params.task_id: Task id (the first 6 characters are enough)
params.now: true only if the user says 'now'/'right away' (skips the Claude night window)
params.engine: Only if the user chooses who develops it: local | cloud | claude

forge_develop.summary: Hestia develops itself: creates/changes/fixes Hestia's code.

params.request: What to develop, in detail, in the user's words
params.services: Services involved if known (e.g. hecate, oracle)
params.engine: Only if the user asks: local | cloud | claude. Empty = default
params.workdoc: To CONTINUE a previous job: folder name docs/work/<...> (from the previous task)
params.agenda_parent: Agenda item key this development serves (cancelling it cancels the task)

forge_dossier.summary: Spec, progress and changelog of a work dossier, e.g.

params.name: Folder name in docs/work (workdoc field of the task)

forge_reject.summary: Discards a proposed or in-review Forge task.

forge_rollback.summary: Undoes a Forge change already applied.

forge_set_claude_schedule.summary: Sets when Hestia can use Claude Pro automatically.

params.window_hours: hours before the reset in which to use Claude at night (default 48)
params.final_hours: last hours in which to use everything (default 6)

forge_settings.summary: Shows development settings: default engine, fallback, local/cloud permission mode.

forge_status.summary: Forge engine status: repo, available engines, queue.

forge_submit_branch.summary: Delivers a fix already made on a repo branch.

params.task_id: Task id (create it first with forge_develop if it does not exist)
params.branch: Name of the branch on origin with the fix
params.summary: What the branch changes and why

forge_task.summary: Detail of a development task: request, state, engine, error, tests, dossier, branch, notes, state history.

params.task_id: Task id (the first 6 characters are enough)

forge_task_diff.summary: Full diff produced by a development task.

forge_task_note.summary: Adds an analysis or a hint to a development task.

params.text: Analysis, cause found, files to touch, how to verify

forge_tasks.summary: Lists the self-development tasks and their state.

params.state: Status filter: proposed, running, awaiting_review, deployed...

away_enable.summary: Turns on or off the address to use Hestia from outside home; only on the user's explicit request.

away_status.summary: Is Hestia reachable from outside home?

garmin_link.summary: Sends the user the form to link Garmin Connect.

garmin_day.summary: Sleep, steps, resting heart rate, body battery, hrv, readiness and activities of a day.

garmin_sync.summary: Reads sleep, steps, heart rate and activities of the last days now and passes them to training and self care.

garmin_status.summary: Whether the Garmin watch is linked and when I last read the data.

params.code: Full URL pasted by the user, or just the code

gateway_auth_initiate_google.summary: Starts the OAuth flow for Google Calendar.

gateway_auth_initiate_microsoft.summary: Starts the device-code OAuth flow for Outlook/Microsoft.

gateway_auth_poll.summary: Checks whether the user completed the OAuth flow.

gateway_auth_status.summary: Checks which providers are signed in and active.

gateway_auth_verify.summary: Checks the sign-in state of all providers and sends Telegram notifications for those that need signing in again.

hephaestus_approve.summary: Approves and runs a pending remediation task.

hephaestus_rollback.summary: Undoes a repair: if it had not started it stops it; if it changed data the module restores them; otherwise it answers that there is nothing to restore.

hephaestus_status.summary: Shows the state of the remediation engine.

image_flows.summary: The uploaded workflows and whether the generator is linked.

iris_reconcile.summary: Runs reconciliation maintenance in the Iris module.

params.dry_run: If true only simulates without changes

machines_brain.summary: Run the local models on a satellite's graphics card; empty address = back on this one.

machines_code.summary: A link code to add a satellite: it is typed in the other machine's installation.

machines_list.summary: Hestia's machines: this one and the satellites, on or off, with the modules running there.

machines_unlink.summary: Unlinks a satellite: its modules leave.

memory_learning.summary: What the assistant learned recently, with the user's exact words each thing comes from.

memory_note.summary: Save in Hestia's long-term memory the durable facts about the user that came out of this conversation.

memory_proposal_apply.summary: Applies a proposed clean-up: only if the user says yes.

memory_proposals.summary: The memory clean-ups proposed by «Review what you know about me» still waiting for an answer.

memory_recall.summary: What Hestia already knows about the user on a topic, so your answer and Hestia's memory agree.

memory_review.summary: «Review what you know about me»: looks for duplicates, contradictions and old things in memory and proposes them.

metis_now.summary: What you need now: actions you usually use at this time, those in the agenda in the next hours and some ideas of the assistant, each with the reason.

metis_benchmark_run.summary: Run a benchmark evaluation comparing a candidate model against the current baseline on a held-out test set.

metis_dataset_build.summary: Build a cleaned, deduplicated, balanced dataset from graded feedback records.

metis_dataset_export.summary: Exports the training dataset to download.

params.include_unreviewed: true = also shifts not yet reviewed

metis_dataset_export.summary: Export a built dataset as jsonl for LoRA fine-tuning.

metis_dataset_status.summary: Show statistics for built datasets: example count, quality distribution, domain coverage, last build date.

metis_loRA_train.summary: Orchestrate a LoRA fine-tuning run on the built dataset.

params.schedule: now = right away; window = in the agenda's night window; auto = right away if the user asks

metis_review.summary: The night corrections of answers waiting for you before entering the training dataset.

metis_review_decide.summary: Decide a correction of the training dataset: accept, reject, edit.

metis_discover.summary: Hestia features you have never or hardly used, with what they do and a button to try them.

models_downloads.summary: The brain's model downloads: what is downloading, done or failed, with progress and time left.

models_download.summary: Download a local model for the brain, by its Ollama name, e.g.

nondisturbare.summary: Turns on «Do not disturb»: only urgent notifications get through.

oracle.compact.summary: Force-compact conversation history for a session via LLM summarisation.

oracle.context_stats.summary: Return token breakdown and context-window usage for a session.

oracle.logs_query.summary: Query Oracle's in-memory log buffer by level and text filter.

oracle.session_info.summary: Return global Oracle state: active sessions, uptime, model in use, Hub connection.

people_contact.summary: Marks that the user talked to/saw a person.

people_get.summary: A person's card: dates, tastes, gift ideas, last contact.

people_gift_idea.summary: Saves a gift idea for a person.

people_upcoming.summary: Birthdays and important dates of the next days with the gift ideas.

people_update.summary: Changes a person; date_label + date_day add a date.

presence_clear.summary: Removes the state set by hand: the assistant decides by itself again.

presence_history.summary: The assistant's latest state changes, with the reason.

presence_set.summary: Changes the assistant's state by hand for a time or until the user removes it.

recap_today.summary: Daily recap: how it went and what comes next.

params.momento: evening = today and tomorrow; morning = yesterday and today

routine_create.summary: Creates a routine in words: an instruction the assistant runs at a time or when something happens.

routine_from_template.summary: Creates a routine from a template with its fields.

deadlines_add.summary: New deadline: title, due yyyy-mm-dd, category, amount €, recurrence, lead_days of notice.

deadlines_advice.summary: A practical tip on this deadline.

deadlines_done.summary: Marks paid/done: recurring ones move to the next date.

deadlines_get.summary: A deadline with tip and amount.

deadlines_snooze.summary: Postpones the notice by a few days.

scout.search.summary: Search real estate listings by query, city, price range, surface, rooms.

scout_fetch.summary: Check listing emails now: Iris passes the last day's listing mails again and Scout parses and extracts them.

scout_stats.summary: Return real_estate domain statistics: total entities, breakdown by listing status, and date range of when listings were added.

selfcare_check.summary: Compatibility of the actives: of a routine, or of a product / list of actives against those in use.

selfcare_diary_voice.summary: Spoken diary: the user tells about the day with a voice message; it is transcribed and saved in the diary.

selfcare_log.summary: Log: routine done or extra use of a product.

selfcare_period.summary: Routines and products in use on a given date.

selfcare_product_get.summary: Detail of a product: uses, expiry, estimate of when it runs out, routines using it, history, previous packs.

selfcare_routine_get.summary: A routine: steps in order with amounts, waits and own frequency, statistics, version history, compatibility warnings.

selfcare_routines.summary: The routines with frequency, today's state and goal.

selfcare_shopping.summary: Self care shopping list: wishes, to buy again, finished with the verdict 'I'll buy it again'.

selfcare_stats.summary: Statistics: consistency per routine, most used products, spending per month.

selfcare_summary.summary: The user's self care: routines, products in use, alerts and what is left today.

selfcare_timeline.summary: What changed over time: routine versions, products opened/finished/replaced, diary.

selfcare_today.summary: What to do today: routines with state, steps to do tonight, steps excluded today.

selfcare_undo_routine.summary: Undoes the last change of a routine's steps.

settings_get.summary: Detail of a setting: description, allowed values, current value, state.

settings_proposals.summary: Settings change proposals waiting for your confirmation.

settings_propose.summary: Propose to the user to change a setting.

settings_search.summary: Search Hestia settings by words: what they do, current value.

settings_undo.summary: Propose to undo the last change of a setting.

special_add.summary: Adds a special event asked by the user, with how many days before to notify.

special_list.summary: Birthdays, anniversaries and important dates, with how many days are left.

special_propose.summary: When you find an important date the user did not ask to save: propose it, the user confirms with a tap.

params.evidence: where you found it, one line

stato.summary: Assistant activity state: awake, waiting, nap, deep sleep, do not disturb, last interaction, jobs running and effects.

sync_calendar.summary: Syncs the calendar events from Google and Outlook into Hestia.

system_analysis.summary: Run a full analysis of the services with AI.

system_incidents.summary: History of the problems and of what was done to fix them.

system_log.summary: Shows the recent errors and warnings of the services.

system_performance.summary: Module performance: memory, processor, response times, data size.

system_status.summary: Shows the health of all Hestia services.

phone_status.summary: Last state sent by the phone and whether the link is set up.

voice_correction.summary: When the user corrects a badly transcribed voice message: heard text and right text; new words enter the dictionary after a few corrections.

voice_dictionary.summary: Your words I pass to voice recognition, and those I am learning from your corrections.

voice_downloads.summary: The voices and listening I am downloading or have downloaded, with progress.

voiceprint.summary: Whether I have your voiceprint and where I recognise only you.

voiceprint_record.summary: Record at least 10 seconds of your voice: then other voices don't end up in your messages where you chose so.

params.audio: A voice message of at least 10 seconds where you speak

voiceprint_remove.summary: Forget your voiceprint: I listen to all voices.

voice_word.summary: Add a word to the voice dictionary.

voice_word_remove.summary: Remove a word from the voice dictionary.

voice_download.summary: Download now the local voices and listening of the chains in use, so the first sentence doesn't wait.

wardrobe_add.summary: Add an item the user says they have/bought.

wardrobe_create_outfit.summary: Saves an outfit from the items.

wardrobe_delete.summary: Deletes an item or an outfit: it does not delete at once, it sends the user a confirmation request with the buttons Delete / Archive / Keep.

wardrobe_log_worn.summary: Mark what I wore, default today.

wardrobe_packing.summary: Prepares a packing list for a trip: one outfit per day from the items available.

wardrobe_piece.summary: Detail of an item: size, materials, purchase, outfits it is in, how many times marked worn.

wardrobe_search.summary: Search clothes, shoes and accessories I own.

wardrobe_stats.summary: Statistics: composition by category/colour/season, value, forgotten items, gaps; use only as a hint.

wardrobe_suggest.summary: «What should I wear»: outfits from the available items with the reasons.

wardrobe_summary.summary: Wardrobe at a glance: how many items/outfits, style, in the laundry, forgotten, last outfit worn, goal.

wardrobe_update.summary: Changes an item: status, favorite, location or other fields in changes.

weather_forecast.summary: Weather forecast by day: min/max, conditions, probability and hours of rain, wind, sunrise/sunset.

params.place: Saved place, address or city (empty = Home)

weather_now.summary: Weather now and today in a place: temperature, feels like, conditions, wind, hours of rain.

params.place: Saved place, address or city (empty = Home)

web_search.summary: Search the web via DuckDuckGo Instant Answer api.

notification_disable.summary: Turn off a notification by subscription_id

notification_enable.summary: Turn a notification back on by subscription_id

calendar_subscribe.summary: Get automatic reminders for calendar events

system_subscribe.summary: Get notifications about the services' status

system_unsubscribe.summary: Stop notifications about the services' status

archive_reconcile.summary: Run a reconciliation maintenance on Archive entity records

params.dry_run: If true only simulates without deleting
params.domain: Optional domain to limit the reconciliation to
